description.value: Meadow Vista Honey Wines is a working meadery and artisan farm on a 5.5-acre property nestled among the orchards of East Kelowna, producing award-winning honey wines (meads) from the honey of 150 on-site beehives. The farm offers walk-in tastings, guided bee tours, and a seasonal farm-to-table bistro with outdoor patio and gazebo seating. It is a distinctive stop in Okanagan wine country, offering something genuinely different from the region's many grape wineries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich, confirming an active meadery with walk-in wine tastings, a farm-to-table bistro, bee tours, and an online wine shop. The FAQ explicitly confirms gluten-free wines (except one product) and the bistro menu lists a vegetarian panini option, supporting a GF/vegetarian claim. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the fetched content; the front-page header reads 'Meadow Vista Artisan Farms' rather than 'Meadow Vista Honey Wines', a minor name discrepancy worth flagging.
